app.lema: Health monitoring for astronauts on missions

datalake.uso:
Usage:
  python index.py ingest goes|donki|radlab|eda [key=value ...]
  python index.py read <source> [from] [to]
  python index.py manifest
Language: VIGIA_LANG=es|en (default es)

error.gold_no_existe: gold «{nombre}» does not exist; run the pipelines/reanclaje ETL
error.gold_alterado: gold «{nombre}» does not match its SHA-256 in the manifest
error.actor_desconocido: provide a valid crew member in the X-Tripulante header
error.sin_permiso: you cannot view or modify another crew member's data
error.linea_base_no_existe: there is no baseline for that indicator and origin
error.reloj_sin_conexion: the watch server is not connected (check SMART_URL and that smart-monitor is running)
error.reloj_sin_tripulante: the watch server does not know this crew member (check SMART_TRIPULANTES or the name on the watch)

app.name: VIGÍA
app.disclaimer: Decision-support prototype. Not a medical device. Environmental data labeled “Real” are NASA and NOAA measurements; in demo mode crew physiology is simulated.

banners.adaptation: Adaptation mode (days 1-14): only safety limits can raise alerts
banners.adaptationDetail: Expected change due to adaptation: only safety limits are monitored. Personal deviation is computed and shown, but does not raise alerts.
banners.stormDetail: A solar particle event is in progress (flux of 10 pfu or more at ≥10 MeV, or a DONKI SEP event). Go to the shielded area until it ends.
banners.demo: Demo mode: simulated crew member with injected anomalies
banners.demoDetail: Physiology and anomalies (drift, CO2 spike, 200 pfu storm) are simulated. Anything labeled “Real” is NASA and NOAA measurements re-anchored to the mission.
banners.realEmptyDetail: In this mode VIGÍA only evaluates what you log and the measured environment. Do your first check-in or view the demo scenario.
banners.offline: No link to the API: working from the local copy
banners.offlineDetail: You can check in and view your status and alerts. Pending check-ins and notices are sent automatically when the link returns.

statusLong.ok: All indicators within your expected range
statusLong.act: Act now. Follow the protocol shown below

layerLong.A: A clinical safety limit was exceeded.
layerLong.B: A reading is outside your personal baseline band.
layerLong.C: A slow drift was detected over several days.
layerLong.context: An environmental or contextual event explains this signal.

checkin.howTo: How to measure in this mission profile
checkin.saveError: Could not save locally. Your data is still on screen; try again.

trends.title: Trends
trends.subtitle: Mission days with your personal baseline band.

env.subtitle: Radiation, space weather and cabin air.

env.noCabin: No cabin telemetry for this day

env.emptyCo2: No daily CO2 series in this scenario.

toast.escalated: Escalates automatically to the medical officer
toast.private: Private: only you can see it

toast.autoClose: Closes automatically. It stays saved in Alerts.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Most recent first. You decide who sees green and amber alerts.
alerts.share: Share with the Crew Medical Officer
alerts.shared: Shared with the Crew Medical Officer
alerts.autoSent: Sent automatically to the Crew Medical Officer
alerts.autoSentDetail: Red safety alerts escalate automatically. This is exactly what was sent, and nothing more:
alerts.pendingSend: Pending delivery to the Crew Medical Officer (no link)
alerts.notEscalated: Saved without escalation: recipient or prior consent missing
alerts.demoEscalation: Simulated escalation (demo mode): with real data it is sent to the Crew Medical Officer
alerts.historyOnly: No measurement time: the notice cannot be sent
alerts.crewShared: Shared with the whole crew (environmental data only)
alerts.informative: Informational: adaptation mode, not an alert
alerts.recommendShare: You have been in amber for 3 days in a row: we recommend sharing it with the Crew Medical Officer. The decision is yours.
alerts.contextPlaceholder: For example: I just exercised; I will repeat the measurement in 10 min.
alerts.cannotCancel: You cannot cancel the notice, but you can add context.
alerts.empty: No alerts yet. When a layer triggers, it will appear here.
alerts.cmoNote: Crew Medical Officer view: alerts shared with you or escalated automatically.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Outbound queue to the Flight Surgeon. Delivery takes the one-way delay.
reports.sendFailed: Could not queue the report: the API did not respond. Try again.
reports.surgeonNote: Flight Surgeon view: reports arrive after the communication delay.
reports.summary: Overall status {estado}. Sent from {perfil} (one-way delay {retardo}; in this demo the queue shortens it to 1 min).
reports.bandText: Personal resting HR band {bajo} to {alto} bpm ({fase})
reports.noEnvironment: No environment data for this day
reports.noAction: No active alerts; following the day's plan

device.title: Device
device.subtitle: Pair your Galaxy Watch to prefill heart rate and run the guided daily check.
device.watchDesc: The watch sends its readings to the smart-monitor server and VIGÍA receives them through its API.
device.simulatorDesc: No watch on board? Stream simulated heart rate.
device.lostDetail: Signal lost. Check that the watch is on your wrist, with monitoring active and on the same network.
device.bridgeOff: The API has no watch server configured (SMART_URL). In the meantime you can use the simulator.
device.bridgeDown: The API cannot connect to the watch server (smart-monitor). It retries automatically.
device.notLinked: The watch server does not know this crew member yet: check the name configured on the watch or SMART_TRIPULANTES.
device.checkDesc: Seated, with your arm supported and at the same time each day: aim for 60 s in a row without movement (2 min maximum).
device.orderFailed: Could not send the command: the watch server is not connected.
device.wellness: Wellness data, not diagnostic data. Only the resting HR and SpO₂ from a valid check feed the engine.
device.curve: Heart rate over the last few minutes
device.instrumentChange: Instrument change ({detalle}): resting HR from before and after is not comparable. VIGÍA resets its in-flight baseline: for 7 logged days HR is evaluated only against the clinical limits (A.6).
device.crewDesc: Only each watch's status and whether a check was done today. Physiological values are visible only to their owner.
device.crewEmpty: The watch server is not reporting any crew members yet.
device.crewDuplicate: Two watches with the same name: instruments are being mixed
device.toleranceDesc: Applies to all watches. Flexible accepts more spikes while still; strict gives cleaner data and rejects more checks.
device.toleranceWarn: Do not change it often: checks measured with different tolerances are not comparable.
device.toleranceSent: Tolerance sent to the watch server.
device.toleranceValues: rest < {quieto} g · spike ≥ {inquieto} g · reset ≥ {sacudida} g · spikes ≤ {picos} %
device.exportFailed: Could not download: the watch server is not responding.

prevention.restingHr: Keep to the exercise protocol, stay hydrated and protect your sleep window.
prevention.systolic: Fluid loading before gravity transitions, exercise countermeasures.
prevention.spo2: Monitor cabin O2 partial pressure and the sensor site.
prevention.tempC: Always measure at rest, at least 30 min after exercise; hand hygiene.
prevention.sleepH: Fixed schedule, lighting protocol and cabin noise control.
prevention.mood: Meaningful activities, private family conferences and crew cohesion.
prevention.glucose: Containment of biological waste in 0 g and adherence to the diet and exercise protocol.
prevention.massKg: Resistance exercise and calorie intake tracking with the same instrument.

catalog.radiationPrevention: Shelter during a solar storm (≥10 pfu at ≥10 MeV) and tracking of the career budget (600 mSv).
catalog.radiationHazard: Space radiation (GCR and solar particle events)

about.provMeasured: Entered by the astronaut or streamed from a paired device.
about.provSimulated: Synthetic physiology and injected anomalies from demo mode.
about.provScenario: Mission calendar: the day on which each real window falls is a scenario decision.
about.provReal: Public NASA and NOAA measurements re-anchored to mission days, with their real date.

0.1: Dose and solar particle events from space weather.

2.1: Communication delay; the crew must act first.

3.1: Fluid shift, bone and muscle loss, vision changes.

4.1: CO2, temperature, humidity and cabin pressure.

about.title: About VIGÍA
about.scopeBody: VIGÍA helps an astronaut assess their own health in under 90 seconds a day and decide what to do without waiting for Earth. It combines three detection layers: clinical safety limits (A), deviation from a personal baseline (B) and slow drift over several days (C), plus environmental context.

common.apiOffline: Could not connect to the VIGÍA API
common.apiOfflineDetail: This is the first time you have opened VIGÍA on this device and there is no local copy yet. It is saved on the first link, and after that it works offline.

banda.A: NEWS2 of 5 or more, or one parameter in its extreme range
banda.B: Outside your personal band two days in a row
banda.C: Cumulative drift over several days (CUSUM of 5 or more)

bandaContexto.co2: CO2 above 3 mmHg (1 h average) with headache
bandaContexto.protones: Flux of 10 pfu or more at ≥10 MeV, or SEP event

causa.A: A reading crosses a clinical safety limit.
causa.B: The reading departs from your current personal baseline.
causa.C: A sustained drift from your in-flight baseline has been building up over several days.
causa.context: The measured environment explains the symptom or calls for action by the whole crew.

causaContexto.co2: You reported a headache and cabin CO2 exceeds the limit: the likely cause is environmental, not medical.
causaContexto.protones: A solar particle event is in progress: storm mode is activated for the whole crew.

accion.fc: Rest, hydrate and measure again early tomorrow.
accion.pas: Sit down, measure again in 5 min and notify the Crew Medical Officer if it happens again.
accion.sueno: Dim the lights 1 h before sleep and set aside a full sleep window.
accion.animo: Schedule time with the crew and describe how you feel in your report.
accion.news2: Measure again in 5 min and call the Crew Medical Officer.
accion.co2: Check the ventilation and the scrubber, move closer to the air outlet and repeat the check-in.
accion.protones: Go to the shielded area and watch for nausea, vomiting or fatigue. Today's readings are flagged.

MOTOR.estable: All readings within your baseline band and safety limits.
MOTOR.sinDatos: No readings for this day yet. Complete your check-in to evaluate it.

zona.head: Report any vision change or headache in your check-in.
zona.heart: Keep to your exercise protocol and hydration target.
zona.blood: Maintain hand hygiene; log your temperature every morning.
zona.mind: Protect your sleep window; schedule time with the crew.
